newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel must not run freight trials - safety body.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel must not run freight trials - safety body.

text.p: The Channel Tunnel safety authority said on Tuesday Eurotunnel Plc /SA would not be allowed to start trial freight runs through the tunnel until the inter-governmental commission gives its formal go-ahead for a restart date.
Eurotunnel this week had pledged to start trial services and said it expected to restart full services in mid-June.

But Jeremy Beech, one of the safety authority members told a news conference: "If Eurotunnel have engaged in publicity on this, it is a matter for them. But there will be no trial run freight services through the tunnel until the commission says they can."
Tuesday's report, which severly criticised Eurotunnel but stopped short of demanding a redesign of freight wagons, will now go to the Anglo-French Intergovernmental Commission.
The IC will make the final decision on when Eurotunnel can restart freight services.
